name: Under the Tree
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on December 1st, 2019.
The paint could be received as a reward for reaching the paid Tier 95 of the December 2019 Challenge.
Under The Tree was added to the possible rewards pool of containers with the release of the January 2020 Challenge.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.

In October 2015, tanks were forbidden from wearing this paint after one wearing it drove into a large pile of leaves and was never seen again. Despite the tragedy, restrictions have loosened a bit since then, thanks to Hornet's Scout radar being available for search and rescue teams.
